Short title, extent and commencement

ACT XXVI OF 2018
ACT XXVI OF 2018
REGISTRATION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2018
An Act further to amend the Registration Act, 1908
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary,
24th May, 2018]
No.
PAP/Legis-2(188)/2018/1772, dated 24.5.2018.---The Registration
(Amendment) Bill 2018, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the
Punjab on May 16, 2018, and assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on May
21, 2018, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of the
Punjab.
It is necessary further to amend the Registration Act, 1908 (XVI of 1908)
for purposes hereinafter appearing.
Be it enacted by Provincial Assembly of the Punjab as follows:
1. Short title,
extent and commencement.---(1) This Act may be cited as the
Registration (Amendment) Act, 2018.
(2) It shall extend to whole of
the Punjab.
(3) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment in section 17 of Act XVI of 1908

ACT XXVI OF 2018
ACT XXVI OF 2018
REGISTRATION (AMENDMENT) ACT, 2018
An Act further to amend the Registration Act, 1908
[Gazette of Punjab Extraordinary,
24th May, 2018]
No.
PAP/Legis-2(188)/2018/1772, dated 24.5.2018.---The Registration
(Amendment) Bill 2018, having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of the
Punjab on May 16, 2018, and assented to by the Governor of the Punjab on May
21, 2018, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial Assembly of the
Punjab.
It is necessary further to amend the Registration Act, 1908 (XVI of 1908)
for purposes hereinafter appearing.
Be it enacted by Provincial Assembly of the Punjab as follows:
2. Amendment in
section 17 of Act XVI of 1908.---In the Registration Act,
1908 (XVI of 1908), in section 17:
(a) in subsection (1), after
clause (b), the following clause (bb) shall be inserted:
"(bb) an instrument which grants power to an attorney or which
constitutes an agreement to create, declare, assign, limit or extinguish, by
way of sale, any right, title or interest of the value of one hundred rupees
and upwards, to or in immovable property;"; and
(b) in subsection (2), in clause
(v), before the semicolon at the end, the following shall be inserted:
"except a document which grants power to an attorney or is an
agreement to sell any right, title or interest of the said value in immovable
property"
